name: MILLEFOLIUM
key_symptoms: Vertigo when moving slowly. Sensation as if he had forgotten something. The head seems full of blood. Convulsions and epilepsy from suppressed menses. Piercing thrusts of pain.
Hæmoptysis in incipient phthisis. Cough, with bloody expectoration, in suppressed menses or hæmorrhoids. Violent palpitation.

gi_symptoms: Hæmorrhage from bowels. Bleeding hæmorrhoids. Urine bloody (Senec aur).
urinary_symptoms: Menses early, profuse, protracted. Hæmorrhage from uterus; bright red, fluid. Painful varices during pregnancy.
